claim_definition: Verifies that every revocation records a reason (role_change, expired, terminated, policy_violation). The reason is included in the receipt so an auditor can understand why authority was revoked.
scope: dgv-verifier CLI execution - revocation reason recording test

input.script:
harmony(1e-12)
bind_authority("officer-42", "compliance_officer", "lending_decisions")
revoke_authority("officer-42", "terminated")
evolve(2)
data(1000)
residual()

test_cases.description: Every revocation must record a reason. The reason must be included in the receipt for audit purposes.
